prompt:
Crea una slide Instagram portrait (1080x1350) per Finvestire sulla regola del 72. Background bianco sporco (theme.colors.paper). Layout: div root position:'absolute' width:1080 height:1350 overflow:'hidden' display:'flex' flexDirection:'column' alignItems:'center' paddingLeft:64 paddingRight:64 boxSizing:'border-box'.

SEZIONI DALL'ALTO:

1. LOGO (marginTop:48, marginBottom:24): usa <Remotion.Img src={assets['logo-f']} style={{width:72, height:72}} />.

2. TITOLO (textAlign:'center', marginBottom:40): span multipli inline.
   - 'Quanto ' — color brand-navy, fontSize:52, fontWeight:800
   - 'tempo' — color:'#E8643A', fontSize:52, fontWeight:800, fontStyle:'italic'
   - ' serve per' — color brand-navy, fontSize:52, fontWeight:800
   - ' raddoppiare' — color:'#27AE60', fontSize:52, fontWeight:800, fontStyle:'italic', display:'block', textAlign:'center'
   - ' il Capitale?' — color:'#27AE60', fontSize:52, fontWeight:800, fontStyle:'italic'
   Usa lineHeight:1.15.

3. INTESTAZIONI COLONNE (width:'100%', display:'flex', flexDirection:'row', marginBottom:20): tre div.
   - Div sinistro flex:1 textAlign:'center': 'Rendimento annuo' fontSize:22 fontWeight:700 color brand-navy
   - Div centrale width:80 (spacer vuoto)
   - Div destro flex:1 textAlign:'center': 'Anni necessari' fontSize:22 fontWeight:700 color brand-navy

4. TABELLA RIGHE: 6 righe, ognuna display:'flex' flexDirection:'row' alignItems:'center' width:'100%' marginBottom:18.
   Dati: [{rate:'2%', years:'36', color:'#E05252'}, {rate:'4%', years:'18', color:'#E05252'}, {rate:'6%', years:'12', color:'#E05252'}, {rate:'8%', years:'9', color:'#27AE60'}, {rate:'10%', years:'7,2', color:'#27AE60'}, {rate:'12%', years:'6', color:'#27AE60'}].
   Ogni riga:
   - Pill SINISTRA (flex:1, display:'flex', justifyContent:'center'): div con border:'2.5px solid {color}' borderRadius:999 paddingTop:14 paddingBottom:14 textAlign:'center' fontSize:26 fontWeight:700 color:'#222'  width:160 margin:'0 auto' — testo = rate
   - FRECCE (width:80, textAlign:'center'): testo '»»»' fontSize:22 color:'#BBBBBB'
   - Pill DESTRA (flex:1, display:'flex', justifyContent:'center'): stessa struttura pill con stesso color — testo = years

5. DISCLAIMER (marginTop:'auto', paddingBottom:32, fontSize:15, color:'#999', textAlign:'center'): '*Rendimenti al lordo di tassazione e inflazione'

Generare il codice come un array di righe nel body, NO primitive esterne.
